fields.hostaway_name: Spacious and Modern Apartment for Rent in Riyadh
fields.hostaway_description:
If you are looking for a comfortable and convenient place to stay in Riyadh, look no further than this amazing three-bedroom apartment. This apartment features a spacious living room with a 70-inch flat-screen TV with satellite channels, a free subscription to Shahid VIP and YouTube Premium, a fully equipped kitchen with a fridge and an oven, and three bathrooms. Free internet and private parking are also available.

But that's not all. This apartment is fully smart as you can control all the lights and air conditioning on your iPhone.
The location of this apartment is ideal for exploring the city. It is only 800 meters to Irqah Plaza, where you can find many restaurants and shops, such as Danube supermarket and McDonald's. It is also 1.4 kilometres to Irqah Square, which has many restaurants and cafes. If you want to visit some historical and cultural attractions, you can drive 12 minutes to Al Bujairi, Diriyah, or 11 minutes to Al Safarat "Diplomatic Quarter". And if you need to catch a flight, you can reach King Khalid International Airport in 30 minutes.
This apartment is perfect for families, couples, or business travellers who want to enjoy a cozy and modern home away from home. Don't miss this opportunity and book your stay today!

This apartment is located in a residential area in the Irqah district of Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The area is home to a mix of single-family homes and apartments, as well as a few schools and mosques. The neighborhood is close to several major highways, making it easy to get to other parts of the city or to the airport.

The neighborhood is a safe and convenient place to live. It is close to many amenities, including schools, mosques, grocery stores, and restaurants.

Here are some specific details about the neighborhood:

* Walkability: The neighborhood is very walkable. There are many sidewalks and crosswalks, and the streets are relatively quiet.
* Proximity to amenities: The apartment is within walking distance of Irqah Plaza, which has a variety of restaurants and shops, including Danube supermarket and McDonald's. It is also 1.4 kilometers from Irqah Square, which has a number of restaurants and cafes.

Overall, the neighbourhood is a great place to live, work, and play. It is safe, walkable, and has a lot to offer.

Do not hesitate to contact us to book an appointment to visit this amazing apartment. You will be amazed by its quality and beauty. This is an opportunity not to be missed to get your dream apartment in the heart of Riyadh.

One thing to mention is that the apartment is fully smart where you can control all lights and air conditioning from Siri on your iPhone.

The smart-home system lets you control lighting and air conditioning from your phone, adding ease to daily routines.

Located in the quiet Irqah district of Riyadh, the apartment is close to Irqah Plaza and Irqah Square, with cafés, restaurants and shops nearby. Al Bujairi, Diriyah, the Diplomatic Quarter and King Khalid International Airport are all within easy reach. It is a welcoming base for families, couples and business travellers.

Internet, parking privé, Shahid VIP et YouTube Premium sont inclus pour une expérience encore plus agréable.

Le système domotique permet de contrôler l'éclairage et la climatisation depuis votre téléphone, pour un séjour simple et confortable.

Situé dans le quartier calme d'Irqah à Riyad, l'appartement se trouve près d'Irqah Plaza et d'Irqah Square, de leurs cafés, restaurants et commerces. Al Bujairi, Diriyah, le quartier diplomatique et l'aéroport international King Khalid sont facilement accessibles. Une adresse idéale pour les familles, les couples et les voyageurs d'affaires.

Boulevard City: 14 minutes by car
King Khalid International Airport: 22 minutes by car
Riyadh Season: 10 minutes by car
Many coffee shops, restaurants, and malls: within walking distance

The location is well suited to exploring north Riyadh, with cafés, restaurants and shopping close by. Boulevard City, Riyadh Season destinations and King Khalid International Airport are all conveniently accessible. Al Malqa is an established, calm district with excellent everyday services.

Al Malqa est un quartier résidentiel calme et recherché, très bien desservi au quotidien.

fields.hostaway_description:
LSA B12 offers a blend of elegance and innovation in 126 sqm. This spacious apartment includes a master bedroom with a king-size bed, private closet, and en-suite bathroom, a second bedroom with three single beds, and a third bedroom with two single beds. It features a fully equipped kitchen, a 70-inch smart TV, free Wi-Fi, and a private parking space. Located in Al Munsiyah, just 17 minutes from King Khalid Airport, it's perfect for individuals, families, groups, and short- or long-term stays.

This 126 sqm luxury smart apartment features three spacious bedrooms: a master bedroom with a king-size bed, private closet, and en-suite bathroom; a second bedroom with three single beds; and a third bedroom with two single beds. The living room offers a comfortable seating area with a 70-inch smart TV, and the fully equipped kitchen includes modern appliances for your convenience. Guests will enjoy smart home features for lighting, climate, and entertainment, as well as a private parking space.

Guests will have full, private access to the entire apartment, including all bedrooms, bathrooms, living room, kitchen, and dining area. They can also enjoy the private parking space and all smart home features. Entry is through a secure smart lock for easy self-check-in.

We respect our guests’ privacy while ensuring help is available whenever needed. Our team can be reached at any time via phone or messaging for assistance, local recommendations, or to address any issues during your stay.

Located in the vibrant Al Munsiyah district of Riyadh, the apartment is surrounded by a variety of dining, shopping, and leisure options. Within walking distance, you’ll find popular restaurants such as Kudu and Al Romansiah, as well as coffee shops, supermarkets, and convenience stores. The neighborhood offers easy access to Al Thumamah Road, making it simple to reach major attractions and business districts. King Khalid International Airport is only 17 minutes away by car.

The apartment is conveniently located with easy access to main roads such as Al Thumamah Road, making it simple to reach other parts of Riyadh. Taxis and ride-hailing apps like Uber and Careem are readily available. Guests have access to a private designated parking space, and additional street parking is available nearby. Many restaurants, cafes, and shops are within walking distance.

Please note:
	•	Smoking is strictly prohibited inside the apartment.
	•	Parties or loud gatherings are not allowed.
	•	This is a private apartment in a residential building — guests must respect neighbors at all times.
	•	Parking is only permitted in the designated parking space provided.

تجمع شقة B12 بين المساحة والراحة والتقنيات الذكية ضمن 126 مترًا مربعًا في حي المونسية بالرياض. تضم غرفة نوم رئيسية بسرير كبير وخزانة خاصة وحمام داخلي، وغرفة ثانية بثلاثة أسرّة مفردة، وثالثة بسريرين مفردين.

تحتوي الشقة على مطبخ مجهز بالكامل وصالة مريحة بتلفاز ذكي 70 بوصة وإنترنت مجاني وموقف خاص للسيارة. ويمنحك القفل الذكي وصولًا ذاتيًا وآمنًا إلى كامل الشقة.

الحي قريب من المطاعم والمقاهي والأسواق، مع سهولة الوصول إلى طريق الثمامة ووجهات المدينة. يبعد مطار الملك خالد الدولي نحو 17 دقيقة بالسيارة، ما يجعلها مناسبة للأفراد والعائلات والمجموعات في الزيارات القصيرة أو الإقامات الممتدة.
fields.description_en:
Apartment B12 brings space, comfort and smart-home convenience together across 126 square metres in Al Munsiyah, Riyadh. The home has a master bedroom with a king bed, private wardrobe and en-suite bathroom, a second bedroom with three single beds and a third with two single beds.

A fully equipped kitchen, comfortable living room with a 70-inch smart TV, complimentary Wi-Fi and private parking are included. A smart lock provides secure self check-in and private access to the whole apartment.

Restaurants, cafés and everyday shopping are close by, with easy access to Al Thumamah Road and the wider city. King Khalid International Airport is approximately 17 minutes away, making this a flexible choice for individuals, families and groups.
fields.description_fr:
L'appartement B12 réunit espace, confort et domotique sur 126 m² dans le quartier d'Al Munsiyah à Riyad. Il comprend une chambre principale avec lit king-size, dressing privé et salle de bains attenante, une deuxième chambre avec trois lits simples et une troisième avec deux lits simples.

Cuisine équipée, salon confortable avec télévision connectée de 70 pouces, Wi-Fi gratuit et parking privé sont inclus. Une serrure intelligente permet une arrivée autonome, sûre et privée dans l'ensemble du logement.

Restaurants, cafés et commerces du quotidien sont proches, avec un accès simple à la route Al Thumamah et au reste de la ville. L'aéroport international King Khalid est à environ 17 minutes, ce qui en fait un choix souple pour particuliers, familles et groupes.

fields.hostaway_name: Luxury Smart Apartment at Nour Prestige Marrakech
fields.hostaway_description:
Experience seamless living in this 120m² tech-forward sanctuary. Step through the smart-lock entry into a vast, air-conditioned lounge integrated with an elegant dining area, perfect for family gatherings. With a master suite, artistic coffee corner, and a fully equipped kitchen, this home is tailored for both short and long stays. Located just 5 mins from Jardin Majorelle and 10 mins from the airport, it’s the ultimate choice for families in Marrakech.

Luxury Smart Apartment at "Nour Prestige" Marrakech
Experience Modern Elegance in the Red City
Welcome to your high-tech sanctuary in Marrakech. Located in the prestigious and secure Nour Prestige complex, this expansive 120m² apartment offers the perfect blend of contemporary luxury and total independence. Situated on the 2nd floor of Building N, you are perfectly positioned to enjoy the best of the city while retreating to a peaceful, air-conditioned haven.  
Smart Living & Seamless Access
• Keyless Entry: Skip the hassle of meeting for keys. Our Smart Lock system allows for an independent self-check-in via a private PIN code.
• Ultimate Comfort: The apartment is fully air-conditioned, ensuring a cool and refreshing escape from the Marrakech sun.
Designed for Families & Long Stays
• Spacious Living: Relax in a vast, sun-drenched lounge featuring a large Smart TV and an elegant dining area designed for memorable family gatherings.  
• Gourmet Kitchen: A fully equipped kitchen awaits, featuring a large refrigerator, washing machine, built-in oven, and a grill.  
• The Coffee Corner: Wake up to your morning espresso in our artistic, specially designed coffee retreat.
Rooms & Privacy
• Master Suite: Features a plush King Size bed (1.90m x 1.60m), a private walk-in dressing room, and its own en-suite bathroom for total privacy.  
• Guest Bedrooms: Two additional spacious bedrooms, each with two Twin beds (1.90m x 0.90m), comfortably accommodating up to 6 guests.  
• Three Bathrooms: Thoughtfully distributed to ensure convenience for everyone.  
Prime Strategic Location
Stay minutes away from Marrakech’s most iconic landmarks:
• Cultural Gems: Just 5 minutes from the world-famous Jardin Majorelle and the YSL Museum.
• Historic Heart: A short drive to Jemaa el-Fnaa Square and the historic Souks.
• Travel: Only 10 minutes from Marrakech Menara Airport and close to the central train station.
Safety & Security
Your peace of mind is our priority. The apartment features an exterior security camera at the entrance, and the entire complex is monitored 24/7 by CCTV in all common areas.
Book your stay at Luxury Smart Apartment and discover the perfect home-away-from-home in Marrakech!

Guests have full and exclusive access to the entire 120m² apartment, including all three bedrooms, the spacious lounge, the dining area, and the fully equipped kitchen. Additionally, guests are welcome to enjoy the "Nour Prestige" complex facilities, including the beautifully landscaped gardens and the swimming pools. Free private parking is also available on-site for your convenience.

We respect your privacy and provide a seamless self-check-in process. However, we are always available to assist you. You can reach us anytime directly through the Airbnb messaging system for any questions, assistance, or local recommendations. Our goal is to ensure your stay in Marrakech is perfect, so please don't hesitate to message us!

Nour Prestige is located in one of Marrakech's most sought-after areas, offering a perfect blend of high-end tranquility and immediate access to the city’s highlights. You are just 5 minutes from the iconic Jardin Majorelle and the YSL Museum, and 8 minutes from the trendy Gueliz district, home to fine dining and premium shopping at "Carré Eden." The historic heart, including Jemaa el-Fnaa square, Koutoubia Mosque, and Bahia Palace, is only a 15-minute drive away. With Marrakech Menara Airport just 10 minutes away, this neighborhood is the ultimate strategic hub for experiencing both the ancient soul and modern spirit of the Red City.

Getting around is effortless from this central hub:
• Parking: Enjoy free, secure private parking within the complex—ideal if you are renting a car.
• Taxis & Apps: Taxis are readily available right outside the gate, and ride-sharing apps (like Heetch or InDrive) work perfectly in this area.
• Proximity: Iconic landmarks and the trendy Gueliz district are just a 5-minute drive away.
• Transit: The main train station is only 8 minutes away, and the airport is a quick 10-minute trip, making arrivals and departures seamless.

• Identity Verification: To maintain the security and standards of our "Luxury Smart Apartment," a valid ID must be provided before your unique PIN code is activated.
• Safety First: For your protection, an exterior security camera monitors the main entrance, and the complex is under 24/7 CCTV surveillance.
• Climate Control: The apartment is fully equipped with cooling air conditioning in all rooms to ensure your comfort.
• Family-Friendly: Our home is ideal for families and professionals seeking a quiet, high-tech sanctuary.

fields.description_ar:
اكتشف إقامة عصرية في شقة ذكية بمساحة 120 مترًا مربعًا داخل مجمع نور بريستيج الهادئ والآمن في مراكش. يتيح القفل الذكي دخولًا ذاتيًا برمز خاص، بينما تمنح الصالة المكيفة الواسعة ومنطقة الطعام الأنيقة مساحة مريحة للعائلة.

تضم الشقة جناحًا رئيسيًا بسرير كبير وغرفة ملابس وحمام خاص، وغرفتي نوم إضافيتين بسريرين منفصلين في كل غرفة، وثلاثة حمامات. كما تتوفر زاوية قهوة مميزة ومطبخ مجهز بثلاجة كبيرة وغسالة وفرن وشواية، إضافة إلى تلفاز ذكي وواي فاي وموقف خاص.

تقع الشقة على بعد دقائق من حديقة ماجوريل ومتحف YSL وحي جليز، وعلى مسافة ميسرة من ساحة جامع الفنا والمطار. يمكن للضيوف الاستمتاع بحدائق ومسابح المجمع. إنها وجهة مناسبة للعائلات والمهنيين الباحثين عن الهدوء والاستقلالية وقرب المعالم الرئيسية.
fields.description_en:
Discover a modern 120-square-metre smart apartment in the calm, secure Nour Prestige complex in Marrakech. Smart-lock entry enables independent arrival by private code, while the large air-conditioned lounge and elegant dining space give families room to relax.

The apartment has a master suite with king bed, dressing area and en-suite bathroom, two additional bedrooms with twin beds, and three bathrooms. A distinctive coffee corner and equipped kitchen with large refrigerator, washing machine, oven and grill complete the stay, alongside a smart TV, Wi-Fi and private parking.

Jardin Majorelle, the YSL Museum and Gueliz are minutes away, with Jemaa el-Fnaa and the airport within easy reach. Guests may enjoy the landscaped gardens and swimming pools of the complex. A thoughtful choice for families and professionals seeking calm, independence and a central base.
fields.description_fr:
Découvrez un appartement intelligent et contemporain de 120 m² au sein de la résidence calme et sécurisée Nour Prestige à Marrakech. La serrure connectée permet une arrivée autonome par code privé, tandis que le grand salon climatisé et l'élégante salle à manger offrent un espace confortable pour les familles.

L'appartement comprend une suite parentale avec lit king-size, dressing et salle de bains attenante, deux chambres supplémentaires avec lits jumeaux et trois salles de bains. Un coin café original et une cuisine équipée d'un grand réfrigérateur, lave-linge, four et gril complètent le séjour, avec télévision connectée, Wi-Fi et parking privé.

Le Jardin Majorelle, le musée YSL et Guéliz sont à quelques minutes ; Jemaa el-Fnaa et l'aéroport sont facilement accessibles. Les voyageurs peuvent profiter des jardins paysagers et des piscines de la résidence. Un choix idéal pour familles et professionnels recherchant calme, autonomie et emplacement central.
